blocks.prompt: 3 (i) Find the remainder using binomial theorem when \((33)^{551}\) is divided by 17.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh remainder ka sawal hai: number ko (17 ka multiple) + (chhota number) ki shakal mein laana hai.
33 ke bilkul saath 34 hai, aur \(34 = 2 \times 17\).
Rule kaunsa? Binomial theorem \((34 - 1)^{551}\) par: aakhri term ke ilawa sab 17 ke multiple honge.
Plan: base ko \(34 - 1\) likhein, expand karein, aakhri term \((-1)^{551}\) dekhein, remainder positive banayein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((33)^{551}\), divisor 17.
Humein find karna hai: remainder.
Tareeqa: Base ko (17 ka multiple) \(\pm 1\) likhenge. Binomial theorem se power = (17 ka multiple) + \((\pm 1)^{551}\) ban jayegi. \(\pm 1\) ki power lena sab se aasaan kaam hai: sirf yeh dekhna hai ke power odd hai ya even.

Base ko 17 ke multiple ke paas likhein
\[33 = 34 - 1 = 2(17) - 1\]
\[(33)^{551} = (34 - 1)^{551}\]
Kyun: 34 ko 17 poora divide karta hai, aur bachne wala \(-1\) aisa number hai jis ki koi bhi power ya to 1 hoti hai ya \(-1\). Isi liye yeh chunaav sab se behtar hai.

Expand karein
\[(34 - 1)^{551} = 34^{551} - {}^{551}C_1\,34^{550}\]
\[+ \dots + {}^{551}C_{550}\,34 + (-1)^{551}\]
Kyun: Binomial theorem mein \(a = 34\), \(x = -1\), \(n = 551\). Aakhri term ke ilawa har term mein 34 hai, aur 34 mein 17 hai; is liye woh sab 17 ke multiple hain. Coefficients kitne bhi bare hon, farq nahi parta, kyunke 17 ka factor phir bhi maujood hai.

17 ke multiples ikatthe karein
\[(33)^{551} = 17k + (-1)^{551} = 17k - 1\]
Kyun: 551 odd hai, aur \(-1\) ki odd power \(-1\) hoti hai.

Remainder ko positive banayein
\[17k - 1 = 17(k - 1) + 16\]
Kyun: Remainder hamesha 0 se 16 ke darmiyan hona chahiye. \(-1\) ko \(-17 + 16\) likha, yani ek 17 udhaar liya. Ab 17 ka multiple \(17(k - 1)\) hai aur remainder 16.
Dhyan dein: Jawab '\(-1\)' likh dena aam ghalti hai; remainder kabhi negative nahi hota.

Tasdeeq
\[33 = 17 + 16,\quad 33^2 = 1089\]
\[1089 = 17 \times 64 + 1\]
Kyun: 33 ko 17 se divide karein to 16 bachta hai (yani \(-1\) jaisa), aur \(33^2\) par 1 bachta hai. Matlab odd power par 16 aur even power par 1. 551 odd hai, is liye 16. Computer se seedha check karne par bhi 16 hi aata hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (ii) Find the remainder using binomial theorem when \((9)^{163}\) is divided by 41.
blocks.explanation:
Yahan bhi number ko (41 ka multiple) + (chhota number) banana hai.
9 khud 41 ke kisi multiple ke paas nahi, lekin \(9^2 = 81 = 82 - 1\) aur \(82 = 2 \times 41\).
Rule kaunsa? Binomial theorem \((82 - 1)^{81}\) par.
Plan: ek 9 alag karein, \(9^{162} = 81^{81}\) likhein, expand karein, phir 9 se multiply kar ke remainder positive karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((9)^{163}\), divisor 41.
Humein find karna hai: remainder.
Tareeqa: 9 ki koi aisi power dhoondo jo 41 ke multiple ke bilkul saath ho: \(9^2 = 81 = 82 - 1\). 163 odd hai, is liye ek 9 bahar rakhna parega aur baqi 162 ko \(2 \times 81\) likhenge.

\((82 - 1)^{81}\) expand karein
\[(82 - 1)^{81} = 82^{81} - \dots\]
\[+ {}^{81}C_{80}\,82 + (-1)^{81}\]
\[= 41m - 1\]
Kyun: Aakhri term ke ilawa har term mein 82 hai, aur \(82 = 2 \times 41\), to woh sab 41 ke multiple hain. 81 odd hai, is liye \((-1)^{81} = -1\).

9 se multiply karein
\[(9)^{163} = 9\,(41m - 1) = 41(9m) - 9\]
Kyun: Bahar wala 9 bracket ke dono hisson se multiply hota hai. \(9 \times 41m\) ab bhi 41 ka multiple hai.

Remainder ko positive banayein
\[41(9m) - 9 = 41(9m - 1) + 32\]
Kyun: \(-9 = -41 + 32\). Remainder 0 se 40 ke darmiyan hona chahiye, is liye ek 41 udhaar liya.
Dhyan dein: Bahar wala 9 bhool kar jawab 40 (yani \(-1\)) likh dena aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[9^3 = 729 = 41 \times 17 + 32\]
Kyun: \(9^3 = 9(82 - 1)^1\) bilkul \(9^{163} = 9(82 - 1)^{81}\) jaisi shakal hai (\(82 - 1\) ki odd power), is liye us ka remainder bhi 32 hona chahiye, aur waqai 32 hai. Computer se \(9^{163}\) ka seedha remainder bhi 32 aata hai.
